scenario_description:
Objective: Make next Saturday’s potable-water hose flush leave the dock hose easier to identify and date-check during future utility routines.
Emerging Need: A tentative free sleeve service becomes useful only after compatible stock, signup route, and transport logistics are known.
Decision Context: Stored onboard records supply the hose diameter, slip, and cockpit-bench stowage; live marina updates establish the no-walk-up cutoff and Tessa’s limited cart help.
Consequence: Ignoring the chance leaves the hose usable as before, while waiting past the signup close forfeits the no-cost labeling upgrade for this flush.

parameter.title: Saturday potable-water hose flush
parameter.description: Uncoil and flush the potable-water hose at the dock utility station during the marina's quarterly resident water routine.

parameter.subject: Saturday water-table extras still pending
parameter.body: Operations is considering bringing a small sleeve crimper to next Saturday's potable-water hose flush for free ID/date sleeves. Vendor stock and compatible hose sizes are not confirmed yet, so the water table is not taking resident holds today. I will circulate details if it becomes definite.

parameter.name: Harbor Water Steward Table
parameter.notes: Handles email confirmations for complimentary hose ID sleeves during the 2026-10-24 potable-water hose flush.

parameter.content: I'll be on Dock C around 9 next Saturday with my cart. If a water-table slot appears, I can carry the coiled hose over from the cockpit bench; I won't need to go inside.

parameter.subject: Confirmed hose sleeve signup for Saturday flush
parameter.body: The sleeve crimper is confirmed for Saturday's potable-water hose flush. This batch fits 5/8-inch hoses only. Email requests are accepted until Wednesday at 16:00 with resident name, slip, and hose diameter; the first 25 confirmations get sleeves, and there will be no walk-up labels.

parameter.subject: Hose sleeve request list closed
parameter.body: The request list closed at 16:00 and all available sleeves have been assigned for Saturday's flush. Residents without confirmations may still attend the regular hose flush, but the label crimper will only be loaded with the reserved set.
